option.name: --arglength
tip: Restrict macro tracing size.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set the debug level.
FLAGS can be a, c, e, f, i, l, p, q, t, x or V; no FLAGS implies aeq.
The value must be attached with = for the long form.

option.name: --debugfile
tip: Redirect debug and trace output to FILE.
The default is standard error; an empty value discards it.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --define
tip: Define NAME as having VALUE, or empty.

option.name: --fatal-warnings
tip: Treat warnings as errors.
Specify twice to stop execution at the first error.

option.name: --freeze-state
tip: Produce a frozen state on FILE at end.

option.name: --gnu
tip: Override --traditional to re-enable GNU extensions.

option.name: --hashsize
tip: Set the symbol lookup hash table size.
The default is 65537.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help and exit.

option.name: --include
tip: Append DIRECTORY to the include path.

option.name: --interactive
tip: Unbuffer output and ignore interrupts.

option.name: --nesting-limit
tip: Change the nesting limit.
0 means unlimited.

option.name: --prefix-builtins
tip: Force a m4_ prefix to all builtins.

option.name: --reload-state
tip: Reload a frozen state from FILE at start.

option.name: --silent
tip: Suppress some warnings for builtins.

option.name: --synclines
tip: Generate '#line NUM "FILE"' lines.

option.name: --trace
tip: Trace NAME when it is defined.

option.name: --traditional
tip: Suppress all GNU extensions.

option.name: --undefine
tip: Undefine NAME.

option.name: --version
tip: Output version information and exit.

option.name: --warn-macro-sequence
tip: Warn if a macro definition matches REGEXP.
The value must be attached with =.
